digest.component_or_area: scripts/ import convention and test collection
propositions: Bare imports of alert_dedup in canary_bridge.py and dependency_audit.py fail with ModuleNotFoundError when test files are run as subsets rather than as part of the full CI session.

CI passes because tests/scripts/conftest.py inserts scripts/ on sys.path at collection time, leaking the side effect to all downstream modules including tests/unit/, masking the failure in subset runs.
Two sibling scripts use bare imports of modules residing in the scripts/ directory without guarding those imports with explicit sys.path.insert calls derived from __file__.

The chosen fix pattern (sys.path.insert immediately above the sibling import, deriving the directory from __file__) is already established in jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py and is invocation-independent across python scripts/x.py, pytest, and importlib.util.spec_from_file_location.
